said: Lemonaid is now ready to share. The owner can set the board's colour to match their site, the board fits phones and grows to the right height, and the project has a setup guide (README), an MIT licence and an example settings file. That was the last task in the plan.
see: Open it: under the board on the demo page, pick a colour and the board changes to match, and the line to copy updates. Make the browser window narrow like a phone and the board still reads well. The project folder now has README.md, LICENSE and .env.example.
